notes:
Same site/nav discovery as Bestsellers (see bs219.json notes). Header mega-menu has a 'New' tab (data-parent="new") whose header label reads 'New Arrivals' for data-collection="new-arrivals" (sitewide); the other buttons under that same tab (home-essentials, ceramic-mugs) are ordinary category shortcuts, not New-Arrivals sub-listings, so they were not treated as children. Brand-specific children were instead found via each brand's own landing page: /pages/procook links 'procook-new-arrivals', /pages/spotzero links 'spotzero-new-arrivals', and /pages/treo links a collection literally titled 'Treo New Arrivals' at the handle /collections/treo-new-arriavls (the site's own typo - 'arriavls' not 'arrivals'; the correctly-spelled /collections/treo-new-arrivals 404s, confirming the typo'd handle is the live/canonical one - used verbatim). milton-new-arrivals was found via the collections sitemap and matches the same brand-child pattern (title 'Milton New Arrivals'). No 'Milton Concepts New Arrivals' or 'Milton Appliances New Arrivals' handle exists in the collections sitemap - checked and none found. All qty values are the rendered

text, cross-checked against each collection's /products.json (limit=250, paginated) distinct-id count; every one matched exactly. No non-English content encountered.
